name: Alan Thomason
why: His own senior class studio portrait. The 1993 Talisman index reads "Thomason, Alan 44" and gives him no other page; p. 44 is a senior portrait grid, four portraits across and five rows down, with each row's four names printed as a block in the column at the left in the same left-to-right order. He is third in the third block, which reads Eric Taylor, Patti L. Terrell, Alan Thomason, Alex Thompson, that is man, woman, man, man; the third row of faces is man, woman, man, man and matches. The four rows above and below check the same way: block 1 is four women and row 1 is four women, block 2 reads Stinson, Stover, Stroble, Swafford as woman, woman, man, man and matches, block 4 reads Thompson, Thompson, Thornton, Tinsley as man, woman, man, man and matches, block 5 reads Torian, Tsang, Vandiver, Vowell as woman, man, man, woman and matches. He was the Associated Student Government member named first in the front row of the 1992 group photograph, which is the same man a year younger.

name: Jenifer May
why: Her own junior class studio portrait. The 1993 Talisman index reads "May, Jennifer 52" and gives her no other page; p. 52 is a junior portrait grid, five portraits across and six rows down, with each row's five names set as a block in the column at the left in the same left-to-right order. She is first in the second block, which reads Jennifer May, Kenny May, Kelley McGough, Joseph McNally, Leigh Melton, that is woman, man, woman, man, woman; the second row of faces is woman, man, woman, man, woman and matches. The blocks above and below check the same way: block 1 reads Landrum, Law, LeBlanc, Lindsey, Marksberry as woman, woman, woman, woman, man and row 1 matches; block 3 reads Miller, Mitchell, Moon, Moriarity, Mosier as man, man, woman, woman, woman and row 3 matches; block 6 reads Melissa Perry, Shelly Perry, Maya Petties, Debbie Proctor, Kriste Puckett, all women, and row 6 is five women. Grid geometry measured off the scan itself: column gutters at native x 406, 525, 643 and 762, row gutters at y 271, 425, 575, 728 and 878. The Talisman prints her given name Jennifer; the archive files her as Jenifer, and she is the only May of that given name indexed in any Talisman of this period. She was a Louisville junior in 1992-93, which puts her in her first year on the Hill in 1990-91.

name: Maya Pettries
why: Her own junior class studio portrait. The 1993 Talisman index reads "Petties, Maya 52"; p. 52 is a junior portrait grid, five portraits across and six rows down, each row's five names set as a block in the left-hand column in the same left-to-right order. She is third in the sixth and last block, which reads Melissa Perry, Shelly Perry, Maya Petties, Debbie Proctor, Kriste Puckett. All five are women, so the order and not the sex is what places her: she is the only Black woman in the block and the third face in the sixth row is the only Black woman in it. The blocks above check the order the same way, block 2 reading Jennifer May, Kenny May, Kelley McGough, Joseph McNally, Leigh Melton as woman, man, woman, man, woman against a row of woman, man, woman, man, woman. Grid geometry measured off the scan: column gutters at native x 406, 525, 643 and 762, row gutters at y 271, 425, 575, 728 and 878. The Talisman spells her Petties in all four volumes that carry her, 1991 p. 180, 1992 p. 223, 1993 p. 52 and 1994 p. 61; the archive files her as Pettries. She was a Radcliff junior in 1992-93, so a sophomore in her SGA year.
